notes.title: New Release Date (September 2nd) and Patch Comic
notes.content:
We have moved our release to next Friday, September 2nd! We are still dealing with a couple issues here in Louisiana (not Tadpole Treble related) which has made us postpone the final release. However, we wanted to keep you up to date on the work that we have done with Tadpole Treble for our final release!

Enjoy this comic, which will detail the changes done to Tadpole Treble!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/7f6ba529905351e3436512a08fae4430765f6534.jpg

notes.title: Baton Mini-Plush Contest and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Note Dodging Amphibians,

Tadpole Treble has been out for over a week!! 
To celebrate we are creating a contest. Today's contest will win you a SIGNED Baton Mini-Plush and an extra copy of Tadpole Treble, to give to your Grandma.

For Today's Contest play "Composition Mode' and create a cool Song/Level. Take a screenshot of the QR Code/Codes and post it (Imagur) to the  Custom Songs Thread  If you are having difficulty you could also post it to the  BitFinity Board and just link your song via post in the Custom Song thread. We will count up to three posts today for your entry into the contest.

Today at 8:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time we will dust off the ole random number generator to pick a post located on the Custom Songs thread for our lucky winner! 

That Lucky Winner by RNG is (Moura_Lord) Congrats!!

Tadpole Treble News:

We are Happy to announce our first patch, Tadpole Treble V 0.1
Here are some patch notes for the current builds:

Current Mac and Win Versions:

-Fixed bug where some 32 bit machines were having issue launching the game. (Conclusion build setting issue)
-Fixed bug where some Mac machines, believe updated El Capitan, were having issues showing a black screen and not just playing music. (Conclusion, it was a Unity bug)
-Fixed a bug where some PC's were having issues showing space bar and not able to read input. (Conclusion middleware bug)
-Added "Resolution Banner" as well as additional "Window Mode" for players
-Added a bigger spark for a certain boss that was a little too difficult.
-Modified Piranha Jungle 2nd Cymbal making the bubble easier to obtain.

Near future changes:

-Steam Achievements
-Level Modifications
-Boss adjustments
-Controller Support

Happy creating,
BitFinity
